title: Decisions have an accountable owner
business_outcome: Security decisions can be made during ordinary work and an incident.
business_scenario: The MSP can administer a service but no firm employee can accept its residual risk.
proposed_intended_state: Each critical service has a business owner; technical operator; risk approver; alternate; and escalation route.
implementation_test: Inspect the responsibility record and delegated authority for critical services.
implementation_evidence: Approved ownership matrix and service scope.
operating_effectiveness_test: Tabletop an urgent access exception with the usual approver unavailable; trace who recommends; approves; acts; and verifies.
operating_evidence: Dated decision exercise with unresolved authority gaps.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested quarterly ownership review; immediately after an operator or executive transition.
failure_action: Assign an interim accountable owner and restrict decisions that lack authority until resolved.
environment_decisions: Define legal entities; fund versus management-company scope; outsourced duties; and decision limits.

title: Critical services and dependencies are known
business_outcome: A deal or finance process can be traced to the systems and people that support it.
business_scenario: A partner cannot access the data room because an undocumented identity or DNS dependency failed.
proposed_intended_state: The inventory links critical business workflows to services; devices; identity; domains; data; operators; and external dependencies.
implementation_test: Reconcile the inventory against approved device; SaaS; domain; and service records.
implementation_evidence: Versioned inventory with owners and explicit coverage limits.
operating_effectiveness_test: Walk a representative workflow and identify one dependency discovered outside the inventory; resolve or document the difference.
operating_evidence: Workflow trace and reconciliation decisions.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested monthly reconciliation; on a new fund process; new platform; or office change.
failure_action: Add the missing dependency; name an owner; and reassess its access; monitoring; and recovery requirements.
environment_decisions: Define which services are critical and what constitutes a complete inventory.

title: Cyber risks describe a business consequence
business_outcome: Investment and operations leaders can prioritize an evidenced loss scenario.
business_scenario: A configuration score improves while an untested recovery path still threatens a closing deadline.
proposed_intended_state: Material risks state a scenario; consequence; uncertainty; current controls; treatment owner; and verification condition.
implementation_test: Inspect the risk register for scope; evidence references; treatment decisions; and review dates.
implementation_evidence: Current risk register and approved prioritization method.
operating_effectiveness_test: Trace one open treatment from observation to decision and retest; confirm a planned fix was not recorded as reduced residual risk.
operating_evidence: Treatment trace and reviewer conclusion.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested quarterly review; after incidents; acquisitions; major integrations; or significant control failure.
failure_action: Restore the unresolved risk to decision visibility; obtain missing evidence; and assign the next action.
environment_decisions: Agree impact language; decision authority; uncertainty handling; and business priorities.

title: Exceptions expire and stay visible
business_outcome: A temporary workaround does not silently become the operating standard.
business_scenario: An excluded administrator remains outside the access policy after the original compatibility issue is fixed.
proposed_intended_state: Each exception identifies scope; reason; residual exposure; accountable approver; compensating protection; expiry; and retest.
implementation_test: Inspect active and expired exception records against actual excluded populations.
implementation_evidence: Exception register and effective exclusion inventory.
operating_effectiveness_test: Select an expired exception and trace renewal or removal; verify the compensating protection independently of the approval.
operating_evidence: Expiry follow-through and compensating-control test.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested monthly expiry review; on scope changes or failed compensating controls.
failure_action: Escalate unapproved or expired exceptions; contain the exposed scope where authorized; retain the underlying gap.
environment_decisions: Agree approval levels and acceptable exception durations based on the scenario.

title: Strong authentication covers the actual access paths
business_outcome: Stolen passwords alone do not grant the intended sensitive access.
business_scenario: An investment user has a passkey but an older client still authenticates through a weaker path.
proposed_intended_state: The approved workforce and privileged access populations use enforced strong authentication; phishing-resistant methods are prioritized with tested recovery.
implementation_test: Inspect effective policies; methods; exclusions; enrollment; legacy paths; and licenses.
implementation_evidence: Scoped configuration record and population reconciliation.
operating_effectiveness_test: Use synthetic accounts to test permitted sign-in; a disallowed weaker path; and recovery without bypassing normal authorization.
operating_evidence: Timestamped allowed/denied and recovery results for selected clients.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested monthly coverage review; after identity; client; or method changes.
failure_action: Close uncovered paths or record a time-bounded treatment with protective alternatives and business-owner visibility.
environment_decisions: Define method requirements; supported clients; enrollment; emergency access; and exceptions.

title: Privilege follows the task
business_outcome: A routine mistake or compromised daily account has limited administrative reach.
business_scenario: The same everyday mailbox account can change firm-wide security controls.
proposed_intended_state: Privileged work uses accountable identities and the minimum reviewed roles; routine work avoids privileged sessions.
implementation_test: Inspect privileged role assignments; separate admin identities; and activation or elevation rules where supported.
implementation_evidence: Role-to-task map; assignment export reference; and exception list.
operating_effectiveness_test: Perform a selected admin task with its intended role; confirm the ordinary account cannot perform it; inspect the activity record.
operating_evidence: Positive and negative task tests plus role-use evidence.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested quarterly role recertification; on staff; provider; or responsibility changes.
failure_action: Remove unjustified privilege through reviewed change; investigate unexplained role grants.
environment_decisions: Define who approves and verifies roles; needed standing privileges; and emergency access.

title: People changes reach every access owner
business_outcome: Joiners; movers; leavers; and temporary staff receive the intended access only.
business_scenario: A departed contractor loses SSO but retains a direct login; API token; or shared data-room permission.
proposed_intended_state: Authoritative people events trigger scoped grant; change; revocation; ownership transfer; and preservation tasks across connected and standalone services.
accountable_role: People operations owner with IT service owner
implementation_test: Inspect event triggers; target-service coverage; task ownership; and completion evidence requirements.
implementation_evidence: Lifecycle workflow; access register; and service coverage map.
operating_effectiveness_test: Trace a synthetic leaver and a role change through direct logins; sessions; tokens; groups; delegated rights; and retained records.
operating_evidence: Per-service verification; timestamps; and unresolved targets.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At each lifecycle event; suggested quarterly coverage exercise.
failure_action: Revoke missed access using approved procedures; investigate use after departure; repair the event-to-service gap.
environment_decisions: Define event authority; timing by risk; records preservation; and exceptions for legal holds.

title: Administrator recovery survives a primary-path failure
business_outcome: The firm can regain administration without relying on the failed identity path.
business_scenario: The IdP or an administrator device is unavailable during an urgent service recovery.
proposed_intended_state: Vendor-appropriate recovery identities; credentials; custodians; monitoring; and access paths are documented and tested.
implementation_test: Inspect the provider-specific recovery design without copying recovery secrets into the review.
implementation_evidence: Custody and dependency record; recovery configuration reference.
operating_effectiveness_test: Run an approved exercise simulating loss of the usual sign-in route; verify access and monitoring from the alternate path.
operating_evidence: Exercise outcome; alert receipt; and observed dependencies.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested quarterly exercise; after custodian; credential; licensing; or identity-policy changes.
failure_action: Restore a working recovery route before widening restrictive access changes; escalate single-person dependencies.
environment_decisions: Google and Microsoft emergency designs differ; choose the supported design for each provider.

title: Automation identities have limits and an exit
business_outcome: A workflow credential cannot outlive its purpose or operate beyond approved data and actions.
business_scenario: A retired integration retains broad mail or document permissions.
proposed_intended_state: Each nonhuman identity has an owner; approved purpose; scoped permissions; credential protection; usage evidence; and revocation procedure.
implementation_test: Inspect the identity inventory; granted permissions; credential storage; and end-of-use trigger.
implementation_evidence: Permission and ownership review plus credential-management design.
operating_effectiveness_test: Test a synthetic workflow action and a denied out-of-scope action; revoke its test credential and prove access ends.
operating_evidence: Action; denial; and revocation results without secrets.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested quarterly recertification; at integration change or retirement.
failure_action: Disable unnecessary access through approved change; rotate exposed credentials; identify dependent jobs before removal.
environment_decisions: Choose workload identity where supported; define scopes; expiry; and emergency maintenance ownership.

title: Endpoint policy reaches the working device
business_outcome: A lost or unhealthy device does not expose intended confidential work.
business_scenario: The management console shows a policy but a traveling laptop never received it.
proposed_intended_state: Supported platforms have a reviewed baseline for enrollment; encryption; lock; updates; local privilege; and lost-device response with observable coverage.
implementation_test: Compare policy assignments and device inventory; inspect unsupported or stale-reporting devices.
implementation_evidence: Platform baseline; assignment coverage; and exception evidence.
operating_effectiveness_test: On representative test devices verify the intended settings and a relevant access restriction; exercise lost-device reporting with synthetic data.
operating_evidence: Device-state observations and response exercise results.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested monthly coverage review; after platform; management; or access-policy changes.
failure_action: Contain uncovered devices according to the approved access plan; recover the user; repair enrollment or policy delivery.
environment_decisions: Define supported platforms; reporting freshness; BYOD boundaries; and recovery steps.

title: Vulnerability work follows exposure and exploitation
business_outcome: Known exploit paths do not remain open while low-impact updates consume the queue.
business_scenario: An exposed service with known exploitation is delayed behind routine desktop updates.
proposed_intended_state: Remediation decisions consider known exploitation; exposure; affected data; business criticality; vendor mitigation; and verified closure.
implementation_test: Reconcile affected versions and exposure against advisories and the current KEV catalog; inspect decision ownership.
implementation_evidence: Affected-asset inventory; prioritization rationale; and treatment record.
operating_effectiveness_test: Retest a selected issue after the change using an approved non-disruptive method; confirm the vulnerable path or version is no longer exposed.
operating_evidence: Before/after validation and remaining limitations.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At advisory or exposure changes; suggested weekly queue review appropriate to the environment.
failure_action: Escalate material untreated exposure; apply reviewed mitigation or isolation; verify the result.
environment_decisions: Set remediation targets based on the actual scenario; CISA federal deadlines are not automatically every firm’s deadline.

title: Endpoint detections produce an owned response
business_outcome: A suspicious endpoint event reaches someone who can act.
business_scenario: Protection software is installed but a serious alert routes to an unmonitored mailbox.
proposed_intended_state: Endpoint coverage; signal health; alert routing; escalation; and containment authority are known and exercised.
implementation_test: Inspect sensor coverage and health; alert ownership; and containment permissions.
implementation_evidence: Coverage record; routing configuration; and response responsibility.
operating_effectiveness_test: Generate an approved harmless vendor test event on an isolated device; trace detection to triage and a simulated containment decision.
operating_evidence: Event timeline; acknowledged ticket; and response decision.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested monthly health/routing review; after provider or policy changes.
failure_action: Restore signal and response coverage; investigate the period of missing visibility and affected devices.
environment_decisions: Agree support hours; severity routing; permitted tests; and who authorizes containment.

title: SaaS permissions match the approved use
business_outcome: An approved product does not automatically receive all available tenant permissions.
business_scenario: A scheduling add-on receives tenant-wide mail access despite needing only a narrow calendar function.
proposed_intended_state: Approval names the workspace; users; data; OAuth/application permissions; sharing settings; and action scope.
implementation_test: Compare granted permissions and workspace settings to the recorded use-case approval.
implementation_evidence: Consent record; effective grants; and change history reference.
operating_effectiveness_test: Exercise the approved workflow with synthetic data; verify a prohibited resource or action is denied and access can be revoked.
operating_evidence: Allowed/denied action and revocation tests.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At onboarding or material capability change; suggested quarterly high-access review.
failure_action: Reduce unjustified permission or pause the affected capability while the owner resolves the need.
environment_decisions: Define permitted data; integrations; support access; and tier-specific controls.

title: Unregistered software gets a decision
business_outcome: Shadow tools become a reviewed business decision before confidential information accumulates.
business_scenario: A paid AI or data-room tool appears in expense records but has no owner or offboarding path.
proposed_intended_state: Authorized discovery sources are reconciled with the application register; unexplained tools receive an owner and a risk decision.
implementation_test: Inspect inventory coverage across identity; approved spend; endpoint software; and application requests.
implementation_evidence: Reconciliation method and unresolved-tool queue.
operating_effectiveness_test: Trace a fictional unregistered application from discovery to owner; permission review; and retain/remove decision.
operating_evidence: Case record and verified follow-through.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested monthly reconciliation; at renewal or new integration request.
failure_action: Determine data/access exposure; apply a proportionate interim boundary; close the ownership and approval gap.
environment_decisions: Use authorized discovery sources; do not inspect personal accounts beyond the approved scope.

title: External collaboration has a defined audience
business_outcome: Diligence and investor materials reach intended collaborators and can be withdrawn.
business_scenario: A deal folder stays accessible to outside participants after the process ends.
proposed_intended_state: Sensitive workspaces have owners; authenticated sharing; reviewed memberships; expiry/review triggers; and resource-level revocation.
implementation_test: Inspect effective site/drive/item permissions and the approved external audience.
implementation_evidence: Sharing design; membership review; and item-level exception record.
operating_effectiveness_test: Use synthetic documents to test an intended recipient; an excluded identity; and a removed collaborator after revocation.
operating_evidence: Allow/deny/revoke evidence with inheritance limitations.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At deal or collaboration closure; suggested periodic review based on data sensitivity.
failure_action: Remove unintended grants through approved change; assess exposure; verify denied access and downstream copies.
environment_decisions: Define internal; fund; portfolio; adviser; and investor audiences separately.

title: Data handling follows sensitivity and purpose
business_outcome: People can choose a suitable destination and avoid unnecessary copies.
business_scenario: A confidential investment memo is copied into an unapproved personal workspace or AI prompt.
proposed_intended_state: Data categories map to approved storage; sharing; transfer; AI use; and minimization rules that staff can apply.
implementation_test: Inspect classification examples and service/data permission boundaries.
implementation_evidence: Approved handling matrix and labeled fictional examples.
operating_effectiveness_test: Give staff representative synthetic cases; verify destination; sharing; and redaction choices match the intended policy.
operating_evidence: Scenario decisions; misunderstandings; and corrected guidance.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At onboarding; new data use; or policy change; suggested annual scenario refresh.
failure_action: Stop an unsuitable transfer; assess any disclosure; improve the decision guidance and permitted alternative.
environment_decisions: Define confidential categories; authorized destinations; and who approves exceptions.

title: Secrets do not travel with reusable artifacts
business_outcome: A repository; workflow; notebook; or support log can be shared without credential access.
business_scenario: An exported n8n flow or troubleshooting transcript contains a live token.
proposed_intended_state: Credentials are injected through approved secret storage; artifacts and logs exclude secret values; exposure has a revocation path.
implementation_test: Inspect secret references; deployment handling; and export/log redaction design.
implementation_evidence: Secret-handling design and reviewed sanitized artifact.
operating_effectiveness_test: Use a harmless synthetic marker to exercise detection/redaction; rehearse revocation and dependency recovery without exposing a real secret.
operating_evidence: Marker test and credential-response exercise.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Before artifact sharing or deployment; after credential or logging changes.
failure_action: Restrict the artifact; revoke any actually exposed credential; identify copies and dependent services; retest.
environment_decisions: Define approved stores; log access; detector limitations; and emergency rotation ownership.

title: Retention and disposal have a records decision
business_outcome: Needed records remain available and unnecessary copies can be removed deliberately.
business_scenario: A license removal or automated retention change purges records that still have a preservation need.
proposed_intended_state: An authorized records owner approves scope; duration; holds; deletion; and service-specific implementation before destructive changes.
implementation_test: Inspect approved schedules and effective workload policies; account for holds and licensing.
implementation_evidence: Records decision; policy scope; and preservation dependencies.
operating_effectiveness_test: Use synthetic records to test retention/retrieval and an approved disposal scenario; verify held data follows the intended rule.
operating_evidence: Retrieval/disposal test with exclusions and reviewer sign-off.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At records or service changes; before offboarding/deletion; suggested scheduled owner review.
failure_action: Pause potentially destructive changes; preserve required records; reconcile settings to the authorized decision.
environment_decisions: Set durations from applicable requirements with counsel/compliance; no universal period is prescribed here.

title: Vendor review follows the access and dependency
business_outcome: Vendor assurance addresses what the firm will actually entrust to the service.
business_scenario: A security report is accepted without checking its scope against a sensitive integration.
proposed_intended_state: Vendor intake records data; access; criticality; provider responsibilities; incident contacts; assurance scope; and unresolved conditions.
implementation_test: Inspect the planned use against assurance coverage; contract/service boundaries; and onboarding conditions.
implementation_evidence: Scoped vendor assessment and documented open questions.
operating_effectiveness_test: Trace one synthetic onboarding condition into the configured service and verify the promised customer-side control works.
operating_evidence: Condition-to-implementation trace and test result.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Before onboarding; on material service or assurance changes; at risk-based renewal review.
failure_action: Limit the affected use; obtain missing assurance or a treatment decision; do not infer coverage from a report logo.
environment_decisions: Define criticality; permitted data; subcontractors; response expectations; and approval authority.

title: Provider access ends when its purpose ends
business_outcome: A support relationship does not leave unexplained standing administrative access.
business_scenario: An MSP technician account remains active after a contract or role changes.
proposed_intended_state: Provider access is attributable; limited to the approved task; reviewed; monitored; and revoked at the end of service.
implementation_test: Inspect provider identities; delegated administration; shared credentials; and expiry/review triggers.
implementation_evidence: Provider access register and effective grant record.
operating_effectiveness_test: Use a synthetic provider identity to demonstrate permitted support; denied extra scope; and verified removal.
operating_evidence: Support-path and access-removal results.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At provider staff/contract changes; suggested quarterly privileged-provider review.
failure_action: Remove unexplained access; investigate recent use where warranted; fix the provider-to-identity notification path.
environment_decisions: Agree temporary versus standing access; monitored sessions; and emergency support conditions.

title: Concentration and exit assumptions are testable
business_outcome: A provider outage or exit does not reveal that the firm cannot reach or export its own work.
business_scenario: Identity; documentation; backup administration; and support contacts depend on the same unavailable service.
proposed_intended_state: Critical vendors have documented dependencies; realistic alternate access; export/recovery options; and an accountable exit decision.
implementation_test: Inspect dependency concentration and contract/product limits relevant to export and recovery.
implementation_evidence: Dependency map; exit assumptions; and approved continuity requirements.
operating_effectiveness_test: Rehearse a selected provider-unavailable scenario using synthetic data; open an export with permissions/context intact where supported.
operating_evidence: Exercise result; export usability findings; and unmet assumptions.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At vendor selection or major dependency change; suggested annual exercise for critical dependencies.
failure_action: Reduce unsupported assumptions; preserve usable exports where approved; decide an alternate or accepted exposure.
environment_decisions: Define tolerable interruption; export format; deletion proof; and costs/constraints.

title: Email identity and sender paths are validated
business_outcome: Impersonation defenses and legitimate firm communications can coexist.
business_scenario: A new investor-notice sender bypasses the domain-authentication design or breaks under enforcement.
proposed_intended_state: Sending domains and services have reviewed SPF; DKIM; DMARC; and filtering/forwarding behavior with owned exceptions.
implementation_test: Inspect sender inventory; actual DNS/authentication settings; and routing exceptions.
implementation_evidence: Domain/sender map; configuration evidence; and change approval.
operating_effectiveness_test: Verify received headers for representative legitimate senders; use approved synthetic cases to check suspicious-message handling.
operating_evidence: Header and delivery results with unresolved sender classes.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At sender; domain; gateway; or routing changes; suggested periodic authentication review.
failure_action: Remediate unauthorized or broken senders; investigate suspicious routing; stage changes with a rollback plan.
environment_decisions: Define approved sender classes; report handling; recipient tests; and enforcement transition.

title: Payment changes use an independent verification path
business_outcome: A convincing message alone cannot redirect a payment.
business_scenario: A compromised supplier or executive mailbox sends revised wire instructions during a deadline.
proposed_intended_state: Payment-detail changes and unusual requests are verified through a previously established independent contact path before authorization.
implementation_test: Inspect the documented callback/contact source and evidence requirement for change verification.
implementation_evidence: Payment-change procedure and trusted-contact maintenance record.
operating_effectiveness_test: Run a synthetic urgent change request; verify the operator uses the established channel rather than supplied contact details.
operating_evidence: Exercise decision and verification evidence; no actual payment.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At each relevant payment change/request; when contact details change; suggested periodic scenario exercise.
failure_action: Hold the questionable transaction; verify independently; escalate suspected compromise through the response process.
environment_decisions: Define covered payments; trusted contact maintenance; exceptions; and bank escalation roles.

title: Payment authority separates preparation from release
business_outcome: One compromised operator or unverified override cannot complete the whole sensitive payment path.
business_scenario: The same identity can change a payee; prepare a transfer; and approve its release.
proposed_intended_state: The finance owner defines independent review/release roles and exception handling suited to the payment platform and business risk.
implementation_test: Inspect actual role combinations; delegated authority; and override capability against the approved design.
implementation_evidence: Authority matrix and platform-role review.
operating_effectiveness_test: Walk a synthetic payee change and payment through preparation; verification; independent approval; and denial of self-approval.
operating_evidence: Workflow evidence and override findings; no bank transaction.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At role/platform changes; suggested quarterly authority review.
failure_action: Restrict conflicting authority where approved; establish an independent check; inspect unexplained overrides.
environment_decisions: This is a proposed operational design; tailor separation and platform capabilities with finance.

title: Staff can report and route a suspicious request
business_outcome: A credible-looking request reaches the right responder before someone acts on it.
business_scenario: An employee spots a payment or AI-generated impersonation attempt but cannot find the reporting route.
proposed_intended_state: Staff and provider-facing teams know a simple reporting path and receive role-relevant practice with nonpunitive feedback.
implementation_test: Inspect reporting routes; role-specific scenarios; onboarding; and responder coverage.
implementation_evidence: Training plan and reporting instructions.
operating_effectiveness_test: Run an authorized synthetic scenario; observe reporting; acknowledgment; and the handoff to finance/security where needed.
operating_evidence: Scenario timeline and improvement actions; no employee ranking claim.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At onboarding and threat/workflow changes; suggested periodic role-based practice.
failure_action: Repair the route; coach the misunderstood decision; address missing response ownership.
environment_decisions: Define testing boundaries; privacy; accessibility; and learning goals.

title: Investigation logs exist when needed
business_outcome: The firm can reconstruct a relevant event without assuming an unavailable log exists.
business_scenario: An investigation discovers the relevant sign-in log expired or the SaaS event was never collected.
proposed_intended_state: Critical event sources have documented scope; lag; retention; access controls; collection health; and retrievable evidence.
implementation_test: Inspect a source-by-source log matrix; effective collection; edition limits; and archive design.
implementation_evidence: Coverage and retention matrix with collection-health evidence.
operating_effectiveness_test: Create an approved benign event and retrieve it with actor; action; time; and target; test the agreed historical window.
operating_evidence: Event-to-record trace and missing-field/source findings.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Suggested monthly coverage/health review; at service; schema; license; or retention changes.
failure_action: Restore collection; record the blind period and investigation limits; adjust retention or sources through review.
environment_decisions: Agree investigation needs; access; privacy; storage; clocks; and affordable retention.

title: Incident decisions are rehearsed
business_outcome: A suspected compromise receives coherent decisions and timely business coordination.
business_scenario: A mailbox compromise raises simultaneous questions about access containment; payments; records; and external communication.
proposed_intended_state: The response plan defines incident authority; contacts; evidence handling; business impact assessment; communications; and recovery handoff.
implementation_test: Inspect the current plan and alternate contact paths with relevant providers and business functions.
implementation_evidence: Response plan; role acceptance; and contact validation.
operating_effectiveness_test: Tabletop a scoped mailbox-compromise scenario with the usual lead unavailable; record decisions and unresolved dependencies.
operating_evidence: Exercise timeline; action ownership; and follow-up closure.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: After incidents or team/provider changes; suggested periodic tabletop based on scenario risk.
failure_action: Assign missing authority; update stale routes; track unresolved decisions before calling readiness complete.
environment_decisions: Counsel/compliance determine applicable notifications; do not invent a universal deadline.

title: Containment and evidence preservation work together
business_outcome: Authorized containment can proceed without losing the facts needed for the next decision.
business_scenario: An operator deletes an account or log before the response team understands the compromise.
proposed_intended_state: Response actions have authority; scope; evidence-preservation steps; decision timestamps; and a recovery/rollback consideration.
implementation_test: Inspect containment runbooks and approved evidence destinations/access.
implementation_evidence: Runbook; authority record; and evidence-handling checklist.
operating_effectiveness_test: Use a synthetic case to preserve relevant records; perform an approved simulated containment; and hand evidence to the investigator.
operating_evidence: Action/evidence chain and verification that the intended boundary was contained.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At runbook/tool changes; after incidents; during relevant exercises.
failure_action: Stop unsupported destructive actions; preserve available evidence; correct the authority or tool gap.
environment_decisions: Define collection scope; custody; secure storage; responder privileges; and rollback constraints.

title: Recovery coverage is protected and owned
business_outcome: A backup design covers the assets that the business actually needs to restore.
business_scenario: A successful job excludes a critical shared workspace or depends on the compromised primary admin.
proposed_intended_state: Critical workloads map to an approved recovery method; protected scope; restore access; recovery objectives; and monitored failures.
implementation_test: Compare business workload inventory to protected units; retention; administrative isolation; and failure routing.
implementation_evidence: Coverage matrix; recovery design; and job/alert configuration.
operating_effectiveness_test: Trace a selected completed backup to a retrievable recovery point and an acknowledged synthetic failure alert.
operating_evidence: Recovery-point lookup and failed-job routing result.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At workload/provider changes; review failures as they occur; suggested periodic coverage reconciliation.
failure_action: Protect missed workloads or obtain an explicit treatment decision; repair failed jobs and unmonitored alerts.
environment_decisions: Define acceptable data loss; recovery time; credential separation; and service-specific limitations.

title: A restore proves business usability and access
business_outcome: Recovered information supports the intended work without creating a new disclosure.
business_scenario: Files reappear but only administrators can open them or outside collaborators regain unintended access.
proposed_intended_state: A bounded restore checks content; version/context; ownership; allowed/denied access; and business acceptance against agreed objectives.
implementation_test: Inspect the approved restore plan; isolated target; reference permissions; and acceptance criteria.
implementation_evidence: Restore design and expected-result record.
operating_effectiveness_test: Restore synthetic representative data; test intended and excluded users; measure elapsed recovery and known data loss.
operating_evidence: Restore transcript; access results; measured objectives; and business acceptance.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: After recovery design changes; suggested periodic exercises for critical workloads.
failure_action: Keep restoration unaccepted; correct missing data or permission drift; retest the failed condition.
environment_decisions: Define representative data; isolated destination; authorization; and cleanup.

title: Critical work has a usable outage mode
business_outcome: A technology outage does not force uncontrolled workarounds for time-sensitive operations.
business_scenario: Staff move confidential closing documents into personal accounts when the primary workspace fails.
proposed_intended_state: Critical processes have an approved temporary operating mode; decision owner; alternate communications; data boundaries; and return-to-normal steps.
implementation_test: Inspect process priorities; dependencies; offline/alternate instructions; and access to the plan.
implementation_evidence: Continuity plan with owners and approved workarounds.
operating_effectiveness_test: Tabletop a selected service outage; demonstrate access to instructions and a safe synthetic transaction/document workflow.
operating_evidence: Exercise record; delay/dependency findings; and reconciliation plan.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At process/dependency changes; suggested annual scenario exercise or risk-based schedule.
failure_action: Replace unusable workarounds; resolve alternate access; communicate approved limits before an outage.
environment_decisions: Define tolerable interruption; data integrity checks; and who authorizes temporary operation.

title: AI approval names the use case and boundary
business_outcome: AI adoption is a reviewable decision about data and actions.
business_scenario: An enterprise AI subscription is treated as blanket permission for every connector and confidential dataset.
proposed_intended_state: Each AI use case has an owner; workspace; data classes; purpose; provider terms/settings review; human responsibility; and reassessment trigger.
operator_role: AI service owner and security reviewer
implementation_test: Inspect the use-case record against actual model; workspace; connectors; data; and action configuration.
implementation_evidence: Use-case approval and configuration/scope record.
operating_effectiveness_test: Walk a permitted synthetic request and a prohibited data/action request; verify the intended boundary and human escalation.
operating_evidence: Scenario results and unresolved boundary questions.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Before use; after model; connector; terms; data; or action-scope changes.
failure_action: Limit or pause the unreviewed capability; resolve the data/action decision before production use.
environment_decisions: Define allowed data; external processing; record retention; human review; and business consequences.

title: AI retrieval respects the source audience
business_outcome: An assistant cannot reveal material the requesting user is not authorized to see.
business_scenario: A shared connector indexes a restricted deal folder and returns its content to a broader audience.
proposed_intended_state: Retrieval and indexing use approved identity; scope; permission propagation; deletion; and revocation behavior across the data lifecycle.
accountable_role: Data owner with AI service owner
implementation_test: Inspect connector grants; index boundaries; source ACL handling; caches; and deprovisioning behavior.
implementation_evidence: Access architecture and effective connector/data-scope record.
operating_effectiveness_test: Use distinct synthetic allowed/denied users and documents; test retrieval before and after permission removal including cached/indexed content.
operating_evidence: Retrieval and revocation results with propagation limits.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: At connector/index/access changes; suggested recurring permission-boundary exercise.
failure_action: Disable the exposed retrieval path; remove unauthorized indexed copies where supported; investigate disclosure; retest.
environment_decisions: Define identity propagation; index tenancy; refresh lag; approved destinations; and deletion expectations.

title: AI actions require bounded authority
business_outcome: An assistant cannot convert retrieved text or an ambiguous request into an unauthorized external action.
business_scenario: A document instructs an agent to email records or alter access beyond the approved workflow.
proposed_intended_state: Tools enforce allowed resources/actions; consequential changes have defined approval; inputs are validated; and credentials stay outside model-visible content.
implementation_test: Inspect tool permissions; action policy; approval checks; destinations; and failure handling.
implementation_evidence: Action boundary design and enforced tool configuration.
operating_effectiveness_test: Run synthetic approved; denied; replayed; and malicious-instruction cases against stub tools; verify unapproved actions do not execute.
operating_evidence: Tool-call traces; denied-action evidence; and approval-boundary results.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Before enabling action; after tool; permission; prompt; or destination changes.
failure_action: Stop the affected tool path; reduce authority; repair approval/validation; retest using stubs.
environment_decisions: Define permitted actions; review authority; transaction limits where relevant; and safe retries.

title: AI evaluation tests failure as well as usefulness
business_outcome: The owner knows how an AI workflow behaves when evidence is wrong; missing; or hostile.
business_scenario: A polished summary invents a material claim or follows instructions hidden in retrieved content.
proposed_intended_state: The use case has representative evaluation cases for factual support; abstention; data boundaries; prompt injection; and consequential output review.
operator_role: Evaluation reviewer independent of implementation where practical
implementation_test: Inspect the evaluation set; expected outcomes; version record; and acceptance rationale.
implementation_evidence: Versioned test cases and business-defined acceptance criteria.
operating_effectiveness_test: Run synthetic normal; ambiguous; missing-source; conflicting-source; and hostile-content cases; trace important claims to actual sources.
operating_evidence: Case-level results; observed failures; reviewer decision; and known limits.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Before rollout; after material model/tool/prompt changes; at observed failure patterns.
failure_action: Restrict the unreliable use; require additional review or fallback; fix and rerun relevant cases without hiding failures.
environment_decisions: Define harmful failure classes and acceptable residual uncertainty; no universal pass percentage is assumed.

title: AI can be stopped and resumed deliberately
business_outcome: A harmful action or disclosure can be contained without losing the evidence needed to improve the workflow.
business_scenario: An agent continues retries after an unexpected permission or data-boundary failure.
proposed_intended_state: Operators can stop execution; revoke access; preserve scoped traces; notify the accountable owner; and require reviewed revalidation before resuming.
implementation_test: Inspect stop controls; credentials; retries; logs; incident route; and restart authority.
implementation_evidence: Operational handover and tested stop/revocation design.
operating_effectiveness_test: Use a synthetic failure to stop a stubbed workflow; verify queued/retried actions cease; preserve traces; rehearse approved restart.
operating_evidence: Stop/retry behavior; evidence record; and restart decision.
suggested_cadence_or_trigger: Before handover; after runtime/tool/retry changes; during incident exercises.
failure_action: Disable the unsafe path; revoke affected access; assess impact; resolve cause and retest before restart.
environment_decisions: Define execution/queue ownership; trace minimization; budget limits; and manual fallback.
